description: For formulas with free names in \(\operatorname{Fin}(n)\), consequence under every assignment is equivalent to sentence consequence after replacing those names by new constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.names_consequence_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (φ ψ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  {FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence φ} ⊨ᵇ FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence ψ ↔
    ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M), φ.Realize a → ψ.Realize a
